prompt: What is the name of the Australian novelist who is one of only five writers to have won the Booker Prize twice and also won the Jerusalem Prize?
answer: The answer is **J. M. Coetzee**. Born in South Africa, he became an Australian citizen in 2006; he won the Booker Prize twice and received the Jerusalem Prize in 1987.
